name: Bases Card Wrap
changes: The wrap box no longer shows a scrollbar and hides the last line when the value fits.
The rule window lists a rule of a property that is not on the cards. Select the trash icon to delete it.
The layout check runs again when you select another view, and a view with no cards adds no scroll work.
tip: Open a base in cards view and run the command "Set card wrap for this view". Each view of each base keeps its own rule.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Card Wrap is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
